import json

    name_to_pcode[name.lower().strip()] = pcode
    name_to_pcode[pcode.lower()] = pcode

valid_pairs_by_pcode = {}
for pcode, constraint in RELATION_CONSTRAINTS.items():
    valid_pairs_by_pcode[pcode] = set(tuple(p) for p in constraint['valid_pairs'])

ENTITY_TYPE_ALIASES = {
    'PERSON': 'PER', 'PEOPLE': 'PER',
    'ORGANIZATION': 'ORG', 'ORGANISATION': 'ORG',
    'LOCATION': 'LOC', 'NUMBER': 'NUM',
    'NUMERICAL': 'NUM', 'MISCELLANEOUS': 'MISC',
}

def norm_etype(t):
    t = t.strip().upper()
    return ENTITY_TYPE_ALIASES.get(t, t)

total_samples = 0
parse_failures = 0
total_entities_pred = 0
total_relations_pred = 0
et_violations = 0
rv_violations = 0
dr_violations = 0
cf_violations = 0

entity_tp = 0
entity_fp = 0
entity_fn = 0
relation_tp = 0
relation_fp = 0
relation_fn = 0

with open(PRED_FILE) as f:
    for line in f:
        total_samples += 1
        doc = json.loads(line)
        parsed = doc.get('parsed_output')
        gold_entities = doc.get('gold_entities', [])
        gold_relations = doc.get('gold_relations', [])

        if parsed is None:
            parse_failures += 1
            entity_fn += len(gold_entities)
            relation_fn += len(gold_relations)
            continue

        entities = parsed.get('entities', [])
        relations = parsed.get('relations', [])
        total_entities_pred += len(entities)
        total_relations_pred += len(relations)

        entity_type_map = {}
        for ent in entities:
            etype = norm_etype(ent.get('type', ''))
            text = ent.get('text', '').strip().lower()
            if etype not in VALID_ENTITY_TYPES:
                et_violations += 1
            if text in entity_type_map and entity_type_map[text] != etype:
                cf_violations += 1
            entity_type_map[text] = etype

        for rel in relations:
            rel_name = rel.get('type', '').lower().strip()
            pcode = name_to_pcode.get(rel_name)

                rv_violations += 1
            else:
                head_type = norm_etype(rel.get('head_type', rel.get('head', {}).get('type', '')))
                tail_type = norm_etype(rel.get('tail_type', rel.get('tail', {}).get('type', '')))
                if pcode in valid_pairs_by_pcode:
                    if (head_type, tail_type) not in valid_pairs_by_pcode[pcode]:
                        dr_violations += 1

        for ent in entities:
            text = ent.get('text', '').strip().lower()

            pred_ent_set.add((text, etype))

        gold_ent_set = set()
        for ent in gold_entities:
            text = ent.get('text', ent.get('name', '')).strip().lower()
            etype = norm_etype(ent.get('type', ''))
            gold_ent_set.add((text, etype))

        e_tp = len(pred_ent_set & gold_ent_set)
        entity_tp += e_tp
        entity_fp += len(pred_ent_set) - e_tp
        entity_fn += len(gold_ent_set) - e_tp

        # Relation F1 (head_text, rel_type, tail_text)
        pred_rel_set = set()
        for rel in relations:
            h = rel.get('head', rel.get('head_text', ''))
            if isinstance(h, dict): h = h.get('text', '')
            t = rel.get('tail', rel.get('tail_text', ''))
            if isinstance(t, dict): t = t.get('text', '')
            rtype = rel.get('type', '').lower().strip()
            pcode = name_to_pcode.get(rtype, rtype)
            pred_rel_set.add((h.strip().lower(), pcode, t.strip().lower()))

        gold_rel_set = set()
        for rel in gold_relations:
            h = rel.get('head', rel.get('head_text', ''))
            if isinstance(h, dict): h = h.get('text', '')
            t = rel.get('tail', rel.get('tail_text', ''))
            if isinstance(t, dict): t = t.get('text', '')
            rtype = rel.get('type', rel.get('relation', '')).lower().strip()
            pcode = name_to_pcode.get(rtype, rtype)
            gold_rel_set.add((h.strip().lower(), pcode, t.strip().lower()))

        r_tp = len(pred_rel_set & gold_rel_set)
        relation_tp += r_tp
        relation_fp += len(pred_rel_set) - r_tp
        relation_fn += len(gold_rel_set) - r_tp

# Compute rates
